meaning: Question about the annual price change
use_when: The customer asks what the April price change means for their bill; no charge is disputed.

meaning: Same charge taken twice - correction not yet made
use_when: Two identical charges for one period and no refund has been issued yet (credit pending or under investigation).

meaning: Same charge taken twice - already refunded
use_when: Two identical charges for one period and the duplicate has already been refunded to the card or account.
A charge raised in error that is neither a duplicate nor an early termination fee.
Explanation of an invoice line, VAT treatment, copy invoices; nothing is disputed.
Change of card, Direct Debit set-up or failure.
The customer disputes an early termination fee, whether or not it was raised in error.
A line-based service (broadband, home phone, business fibre or voice, mobile network) does not connect at all.
The service connects but drops and returns; calls cut off mid-call.

meaning: Speed below the guaranteed minimum - line or network
use_when: Broadband below the plan's guaranteed minimum where the line test or network shows the cause on our side.
The line tests at plan speed and the shortfall is in the customer's in-home Wi-Fi.
A device we supplied (handset, router, TV box) is physically faulty: no power, cracked or flickering screen, failed port.

meaning: TV - no picture or picture breaking up
use_when: Lumen TV shows no picture, 'no signal', or a picture breaking up, with the box itself working.
Calls connect and stay up but audio is poor (echo, one-way audio, crackle).
Legacy @lumenmail mailbox not sending or receiving.

meaning: Moving home - new install on schedule
use_when: Moving home; an installation at the new address is booked and on its original date.

meaning: Moving home - new install moved later by Lumen
use_when: Moving home; Lumen moved the installation at the new address to a later date.
Moving home; the service transfers to the new address with no installation.
An engineer visit is booked to fix something at the premises.
An engineer did not attend a booked appointment.
A number port in or out is in progress and on its date.

meaning: Port delayed by the donor network
use_when: A port-in is late because the losing (donor) network has not released the number.

meaning: How to use or add to a product
use_when: How to set up, use or add to a product the customer already has (add-on pods, extra boxes, call divert).
Whether a telecare, alarm or monitoring device works with a Lumen service.
Contract end date, minimum term, notice and leaving terms.
What the customer could move to instead of what they have now (another plan or technology); a sales enquiry from an existing customer.
Channel line-ups, packs and boosts.
Network availability at an address.
Transfer of the account to another person.
The customer asks to close the account now (not a question about leaving terms).
Stop marketing calls, mail or messages.
Praise for a person or a service.
A complaint about service in general that is not a fault or a billing error.
Switch between paper and online bills.
